status: Exploratory local protocol, fixed before numerical image analysis and crib scan; not preregistered externally
question: Can raw f116v imaging reduce reading ambiguity, and can a literal proposed charm be located under a fixed substitution model?
not_blind: Existing readings and f104r correspondence were known before this study.

spectral.registration: Integer translation by bounded normalized high-pass correlation, range -6 to +6 pixels per axis; validate on three disjoint areas; no elastic warping
spectral.normalization: 3x3 median filter, then negative log ratio to 101x101 local mean; this is relative contrast, not physical reflectance calibration
spectral.pca: 50,000 sampled pixels, fixed seed 20261030; standardized bands; first three components retained from all bands, reflection 001-012, and fluorescence 013-022
spectral.native_band_audit: All 22 native bands retained. A PCA feature alone is not evidence of writing or a new character.
spectral.claim_limit: No identification of ink chemistry, hand, chronology or sound values from these images. Repeated bands are not independent historical witnesses.

crib.qualification: Tentative published marginal reading, not independently known plaintext and not a demonstrated translation of any main-text passage
tokenizations: composed cth ckh cph cfh ch sh
models: bijection of glyph units to Latin characters
homophonic cipher with deterministic decryption and multiple glyphs permitted for one Latin character
crib.search: Four consecutive words with lengths 3,5,5,3 within one paragraph; separately 16-unit windows ignoring word boundaries within one paragraph
crib.exclusions: f116v excluded; uncertain signs, nonalphabetic data, missing text and illustration gaps cannot be wildcards
crib.controls: Synthetic positive examples, contradictory repeated symbols, and exhaustive independent mapping verification of every accepted candidate
crib.claim_limit: A match is only a constraint-compatible candidate; no language, translation, or decipherment claim without independent held-out prediction. Failure rejects only these finite model/reading combinations.
